title: Digital Edition of the Ethica Complementoria
notes: Annika Rockenberger's GitHub project holds the TEI P5 transcriptions and analysis code for her digital scholarly edition of the 17th-c. German etiquette prints of the Ethica Complementoria tradition, part of the Greflinger digital edition project (https://greflinger.hypotheses.org/). The texts counted here are A3 (1648), C3 (1665), Complementierbüchlein (B6, 1660), Cochleatio Novissima (1656) and Klag und Trost (1652). The Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel published the accompanying bibliographical study (2017); the edition of the 1643 print is published at the Deutsches Textarchiv (https://www.deutschestextarchiv.de/nn_ethica_1643). The project has moved to the companion repository https://github.com/greflinger-dse/EthicaComplementoria; data on GitHub under CC-BY. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Annika Rockenberger (Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel / University of Oslo)
